episodes.synopsis: Mitsugu Bamba, who loves to donate blood, encounters vampire girl Maid Vlad Transylvania.
episodes.title: Vampire Girl, Bloody Excited

episodes.synopsis: Mitsugu discovers that different types of blood affect Mai's personality. Mai ends up drunk and goes on a night-time romp.
episodes.title: Night Flight on Love

episodes.synopsis: Maki invites Mai for a garlic dinner and Kaoru invites Mai for a costume party, and she ends up causing trouble at both venues.
episodes.title: Sabbath Night Fever

episodes.synopsis: Everyone is now suspicious of Mai and want to know more about her. Mitsugu attempts to hide Mai, but a bottle of dragon blood turns Mai into a rampaging monster.
episodes.title: Salamander's Night

episodes.synopsis: The fathers of Mai and Mitsugu, a vampire and a vampire hunter, pay a visit to see their daughters.
episodes.title: Daddy Came

episodes.synopsis: The Blood Donation Club puts on a stage play.
episodes.title: Castle of Vania

episodes.synopsis: The Blood Donation Club makes a film.
episodes.title: Day for Night

episodes.synopsis: The nurse hangs on to a special bottle of blood from her youth. Everyone wants to know the history of that bottle.
episodes.title: Looong story...

episodes.synopsis: Mitsugu travels around a wonderland looking for blood and meets the Blood Donation Club in various new roles.
episodes.title: Bolt Style

episodes.synopsis: The Blood Donation club meets Mai's fiancée, the undead monster Franken Yasohachi.
episodes.title: Fiancé's a Frankenstein's Monster

episodes.synopsis: The Blood Donation Club heads to a isolated island for a summer holiday. However, a fish monster is on the island and Nami goes missing.
episodes.title: A Midsummer Night's Operation: Mystery

episodes.synopsis: Mai agrees to an interview about her history.
episodes.title: Interview With Mai
